statement: NVIDIA is extending its stack toward local and agentic inference, announcing partner work on faster local inference and agentic cybersecurity in the same week.
why: Broadening from data-center training into local and agentic inference is how the vendor defends demand as training growth normalises.

impact.mechanism: New inference and agent workloads on NVIDIA hardware add demand pools beyond hyperscaler training clusters.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA, Microsoft and partners teaming up to provide faster inference and new tools for agents to run locally on NVIDIA hardware

confidence.basis: Primary newsroom listing, but the item is a product announcement with no volumes, revenue or guidance attached.

dispersion: No Rubin ramp update, export-control item or revised financial guidance appeared in the same newsroom window.
